combo_label: Time & Clocks × Horses & Riding × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: God who laid his hand in a wolf's jaws as surety, and lost it when the bond held
World ash whose three roots drink from wells while a dragon gnaws below
Bound over a puddle; also the sort of year that runs to 366 days
Sweet run of notes from a doorbell, or from the tower at quarter past
Bitless head strap for leading and tying up; also a style of neck-tied top
Give the key its weekly turns so the old grandfather keeps going
Monday to Sunday inclusive, then you do the whole thing again
Headlong four-beat pace, the fastest an animal has in it
Yard visitor with an anvil in the van, rasp in hand and nails in his mouth
Angular mark cut in stone or bone, carrying spells and the names of the dead
Shining god slain by a mistletoe dart guided by a trickster's hand
Reddish-brown coat with black lower legs and tail; also a hound's cry
